items.name: Order book trends, Q3 FY2026 earnings release
items.claim: Deere reported that order book trends reinforce 2026 as the bottom of the ag equipment cycle, per its third-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings release.
items.source_excerpt: Order book trends reinforce 2026 as the bottom of the ag equipment cycle.

notes: Q3 FY2026 8-K earnings release (EX-99.1) is the only stored evidence for Deere. It confirms qualitative order-book strength framed against the bottom of the ag cycle, which bears on diesel-demand-anchor exposure, but discloses no segment-level or dollar backlog figure at this level of the release.
